title: Observation: the handoff package ships every stage document verbatim, and filters on `.md`
summary: `lib/handoff/publish.mjs` reads `planning-content/stages/`, filters `readdirSync(dir).filter((f) => f.endsWith(".md"))`, and copies each file's text unchanged into the package — the code comments it as "Stage narratives ship as-is: they are authored planning content, not generated output." The published package at `docs/plan/` contains nine such documents under `docs/`, one per stage, at snapshot 6c86330767dcbbfa.

omissions.reason: What a recipient DOES with a package is outside this repository. The package ships document text; whether anyone compiles it, and with which toolchain, cannot be observed from here — which is exactly why the property matters rather than why it does not.

No `.mdx` file exists under `planning-content/stages/`, so the filter's behaviour on one was read from the source rather than exercised. Running it would need a stage document that does not yet exist.

notes: ⚠️ Recorded as an observation of THIS repository because the consequence below is not derivable from any external source, and it is the point at which an ecosystem CVE becomes a fact about this project rather than an interesting story about someone else's.
